inspect.rule: tenantId must equal the trusted runtime tenant; return the current project manager, lifecycle, stage, project version, participant fact version and current tree version without a write

lockAndRevalidate.rule: join the caller transaction; lock and compare every frozen axis before COM locks or writes

qualification.subject: actorId must equal the current PROJECT_MANAGER; global role or ordinary participation is insufficient
qualification.scope: for this direct-target write contract, ProjectScopeApi.ACTION_EDIT entitlement is proven only by actorId equalling the locked target project current manager; no descendant scope or AuthorizationGrantApi/listEffective fact is consulted
qualification.lifecycleStageInvariant: Every project references its last real instantiated template stage; closed lifecycles do not require S6 and preserve closed_from_stage
qualification.stage: Return and revalidate the real template stage exactly; acceptance-bound scope and all three closed lifecycles remain protected against ordinary reductions/releases
qualification.identity: rootProjectId is positive and frozen explicitly; a root identity change is FACT_STALE
qualification.versions: projectVersion and participantFactVersion are nonnegative; treeVersion is positive

errorDecisionOrder: malformed public query or expected fact => INVALID_REQUEST
explicit tenant differs from trusted runtime tenant => TENANT_CONTEXT_MISMATCH
inspect target missing or not visible in the direct-target contract => DATA_SCOPE_DENIED
validate every present locked current Owner fact; any impossible lifecycle-stage, identity or version structure => OWNER_DATA_CORRUPTED
inspect actor differs from the locked current manager => SUBJECT_NOT_ELIGIBLE
lockAndRevalidate only after current Owner structure is valid; any mismatch against the frozen fact, including simultaneous manager and version changes, => FACT_STALE
transaction or database Provider unavailable => PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
forbidden: reuse ProjectParticipantFactApi ACTIVE/S1 revalidation for this purpose
map every PROJ failure to provider unavailable
accept subject, scope or stale failures as partial success
reviewBoundary: Target contract corrected; provider implementation and database/runtime evidence are not revalidated by this documentation change
